source.title: VMware Cloud Foundation Operations API
source.projectionRule: Project only the seven operations this triage workflow issues, plus the schema members needed to build their request bodies and read their responses. Every field below is copied from the pinned OpenAPI JSON specification, not from a rendered documentation page.

OpsToken.name: Authorization
OpsToken.note: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops sends the acquireToken session secret as Authorization: OpsToken <token> on every later request.

operations.summary: Acquire a token to perform REST API calls

200.description: The token and expiry time of the token

operations.summary: Get the current version of the service

200.description: The current version of the Server

operations.summary: Gets a listing of resources based on the query spec specified

200.description: The Collection of Resources matching the specified query parameters

operations.summary: Query for Alerts using one or more criteria specified in the Query Spec

200.description: The Collection of Alerts matching the specified Query Spec (Collection can be empty)

500.description: Error occurred while retrieving the Alerts

operations.summary: Get the list of triggered symptoms for the requested alerts

200.description: On success. A list of triggered symptoms

500.description: Error occurred while retrieving the list of triggered symptoms

operations.summary: Look up a set of Symptoms using a query object

200.description: List of all Symptoms that match the given query

badges.description: The various major and minor badges and their values for a Resource. If certain badges are not present in the list then either those badges are not applicable to this resource or the calculation of those badges has been disabled for this resource.

creationTime.description: Time the Resource was created in the system. This is a 'read-only' property and is system generated.The server ignores any changes to this field when trying to update a resource.

credentialInstanceId.description: Credential instance identifier assigned to this Resource, applicable only for adapter instances.

dtEnabled.description: DT calculation enabled or not. By default DT calculation for a resource is enabled (during its creation).

identifier.description: Identifier of the Resource (typically a UUID).

monitoringIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds part of the monitoring Interval of the resource, applicable only for adapter instances.

items.description: Collection of related resource identifiers

resourceHealth.description: Enumeration that identifies the health of a Resource

resourceHealthValue.description: Resource Health Score. This is a 'read-only' property and its value is computed by the system. The server ignores any changes to this field when trying to update a resource.

resourceStatusStates.description: The resource status and resource state for this resource as reported by one or more adapter instances. The server ignores any changes to this field when trying to update a resource.

resourceState.description:
Resource State enumerates the collection state for a particular resource.
It does not represent the data collection status which is enumerated by ResourceDataCollectionStatus

resourceStatus.description: Enumeration of resource data collection status.

alert-query.description:
Query for alerts by various criteria.
Composition of filtering criteria controlled via the compositeOperator property.
For Pagination see PageInfo
For sorting see AlertField and SortOrder enumerations.
If a sort field is not specified but pagination is requested the Alerts will be
sorted by the alertId field.

activeOnly.description: Filter to return only Active alerts, if true, the query will exclude Suspended and Cancelled Alerts

alertControlState.description: Filter based on the Alert Control State

items.description: The control state of an Alert
The Criticality level

alertDefinitionId.description: Filter based on the Alert definition id

items.description: Filter based on the Alert definition id
Filter based on Alert identifiers

alertImpact.description: Filter based on the Alert Impact

items.description: Filter based on the Alert Impact

alertName.description: Filter based on Alert name using 'contains' logic

alertStatus.description:
Filter based on the Alert Status. If looking for only active alerts combined
with other filter criteria then use the activeOnly property instead.

items.description:
Indicates the current condition of an Alert.
Used to determine if the conditions for the Alert still continue to exist.

extractOwnerName.description: Indicates whether need to report alert owner's name in addition to owner's id

groupId.description: Filter based on alert group id

includeChildrenResources.description: True to include alerts generated by child resources

resourceKind.description: Filter based on resource kind using 'contains' logic

userName.description: Filter based on user name using 'contains' logic

alertDefinitionId.description: The identifier of the Alert Definition that defined this Alert

alertDefinitionName.description: Localized name of the associated Alert Definition

cancelTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert was cancelled

controlState.description: The control state of an Alert

ownerId.description: The unique ID for the user account that owns this Alert

ownerName.description: The user-name of the user account that owns this Alert

resourceId.description: The UUID of the Resource causing the Alert

startTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert started

statKey.description:
The stat-key related to the violating alert. The alert may be associated with a stat-key and not have
an associated alertDefinitionId if the alert was generated through an external event.

status.description:
Indicates the current condition of an Alert.
Used to determine if the conditions for the Alert still continue to exist.

suspendUntilTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the suspended Alert will resume

type.description: The Alert Type describing the Alert

updateTimeUTC.description: The UTC time when the Alert was updated

contributing-symptoms.description: List of symptoms contributing to the alert

contributingSymptoms.description: List of symptoms. This field is populated only with symptoms that are defined on 'SELF'.

contributing-symptom.description: List of symptoms. This field is populated only with symptoms that are defined on 'SELF'.

symptomDefinitionsIds.description: The Symptom Definitions describing the violated rule for this Symptom

items.description: The Symptom Definitions describing the violated rule for this Symptom

symptomId.description: The UUID that identifies the Symptom

symptomSetId.description: The id of symptom set to which symptom belongs

symptom-query.description:
Query for Symptoms using various criteria.
Composition of filtering criteria controlled via the compositeOperator property.
Pagination of the Symptoms that are returned can be controlled via the PageInfo object.
Sorting of the Symptoms is specified via the SymptomField object and the SortOrder
object controls the order in which the Symptoms are sorted.
If a sort field is not specified but pagination is requested the Symptoms will be sorted
by the alarmId property.

activeOnly.description:
Include Symptoms that are currently Active.
By default, only active Symptoms are included in the result

alarmCriticality.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom Criticalities

items.description: The Criticality level

alarmType.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom Types

items.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom Types

includeAlarmInfo.description: Boolean that controls the retrieval of alarm information of the symptom

includeChildrenResources.description: Whether to include Symptoms of all the children of resources identified by resourceIds

statKey.description: Return Symptoms that have been generated because of violations on the Stat Keys specified

items.description: Return Symptoms that have been generated because of violations on the Stat Keys specified

symptomDefinitionId.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom Definitions

items.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom Definitions

symptomId.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom identifiers

items.description: Return Symptoms that have the specified list of Symptom identifiers

alarmInfo.description:
Additional information of the symptom.
NOTE: General recommendation is not to rely on the current format of the message content
since it can be changed by the source of alarm information at any time.
So, backward compatibility of the content of the message format is not guaranteed.

cancelTimeUTC.description: Time when the symptom was canceled

faultDevices.description: Additional information of the faulted devices.

id.description: The ID which identifies the Symptom

kpi.description: True, if the symptom is a KPI, false otherwise

message.description:
The message associated with a symptom.
This is usually applicable for Event based Symptoms

resourceId.description: The ID of the resource on which the Symptom was generated

symptomDefinitionId.description: The Symptom Definition describing the violated rule for this Symptom

updateTimeUTC.description: Last updated time of the symptom

time-range.description: Filter based on matching UTC cancel time

page-info.description: Represents page information for a paged result

pageSize.description: Number of entries allowed in a page

sortBy.description: A CSV list of field names. Usually found in an enumeration, e.g. ResourceField

sortOrder.description: A CSV list of SortOrder values. If not specified or if list is shorter than sortFields then SortOrder.ASCENDING is assumed.

focusedWorkflow.evidenceBoundary: The verdict must come from validated resources, alerts, alert-contributing-symptoms and symptoms response members. Alert display names, the caller's object name and free-text status messages are not evidence.
focusedWorkflow.specificationBoundary: This contract is a projection of the pinned OpenAPI JSON specification listed in source; no documentation page is a contract source.
